# CBBBioc

This package experimentally defines a Bioconductor interface to Genentech's
[CompBioBench](https://github.com/genentech/compbiobench-runner).  CompBioBench
is a framework for evaluating agentic solutions to
computational biology questions.

`CBBBioc` includes a snapshot of the question set (`v1qs`)
available around October 2026. The package includes
tooling to

- locate in cloud storage the input files each question needs (`cbb_url()`),
- stages per-question agent workspaces (`cbb_setup_workspace()`) in the same `workspace/` 
- set up the `prompt.md` needed by [`compbiobench-runner`](https://github.com/genentech/compbiobench-runner).

See the package vignette for a worked example.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("vjcitn/CBBBioc")
```

## Question catalog

```{r load}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(CBBBioc)
  library(DT)
})
data(v1qs)
```

`v1qs` currently holds `r nrow(v1qs)` questions across these domains:

```{r domtab, results="asis"}
dom_summary = do.call(rbind, lapply(sort(unique(v1qs$domain)), function(d) {
  sub = v1qs[v1qs$domain == d, ]
  exts = unique(unlist(lapply(
    strsplit(sub$file_paths[sub$file_paths != ""], ", "),
    function(z) tools::file_ext(gsub(" ", "", z))
  )))
  exts = exts[exts != ""]
  data.frame(
    Domain = d,
    Freq = nrow(sub),
    `File types used` = if (length(exts)) paste(sort(exts), collapse = ", ") else "(none)",
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}))
knitr::kable(dom_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

One example question per domain, wrapped (not truncated) to a fixed
width so it reads without horizontal scrolling in any viewer:

```{r domexamples, results="asis"}
for (d in sort(unique(v1qs$domain))) {
  cat(sprintf("\n**%s**\n\n", d))
  cat("```\n")
  cat(strwrap(v1qs$question[v1qs$domain == d][1], width = 50), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n```\n")
}
```

`r sum(v1qs$file_paths != "")` of the `r nrow(v1qs)` questions have one or
more associated input files, retrievable via `cbb_url()` and stageable with
`cbb_setup_workspace()`.

### Browse the full catalog

**[Browse all questions (interactive table)](https://vjcitn.github.io/CBBBioc/articles/question-catalog.html)**

*(the site at <https://vjcitn.github.io/CBBBioc/> is built with
[`pkgdown`](https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/) from this README, the vignettes, and
the function reference; regenerate it with `pkgdown::build_site()`.)*

A plain-text preview of the first few questions, for quick browsing here:

```{r preview, results="asis"}
preview = v1qs[, c("question_id", "domain", "question_style", "question")]
preview$question = ifelse(
  nchar(preview$question) > 90,
  paste0(substr(preview$question, 1, 87), "..."),
  preview$question
)
# render as inline code so bare URLs in the question text are not
# interpreted (and truncated mid-link) as markdown autolinks
preview$question = paste0("`", preview$question, "`")
knitr::kable(head(preview, 10), row.names = FALSE)
```

Production of README.md:
```
rmarkdown::render("README.Rmd", output_format = "github_document", output_file = "README.md", quiet = TRUE)
```
